questions.question: Who has assumed charge as the Chief of Personnel of the Indian Navy on November 1, 2025?
questions.solution:
**Correct Answer:** (b) **Vice Admiral Gurcharan Singh**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__****

__
 
• ** Vice Admiral Gurcharan Singh, AVSM, NM, assumed charge as the Chief of Personnel of the Indian Navy on November 1, 2025, after a distinguished career in operational and strategic naval leadership.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Alumnus of **National Defence Academy (Khadakwasla)**; commissioned in **1990**.
 
• Served on **INS Ranjit** and **INS Prahar**; part of commissioning of **INS Brahmaputra, Shivalik, and Kochi**.
 
• Commanded **INS Khukri** and **INS Vidyut**; awarded **Unit Citation (2011)**.
 
• Previously **Commandant of NDA**, **F.O.C. Eastern Fleet**, and **Controller Personnel Services**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **

 
• Holds **MSc** and **MPhil in Defence & Strategic Studies**.
 
• Awards: **AVSM (2024)**, **Nausena Medal (2020)**, and **FOC-in-C Commendation (2002)**.
 
• Completed **Maritime Intelligence Course (NIU, Washington)** and **UNSOC (Stockholm)**.
 
• Advocated welfare and personnel development within the Navy under the vision of **“Ordnance on Target.”**

questions.question: The Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana High Court is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Sheel Nagu**__.

__
 
• **Justice Sheel Nagu** is serving as the **Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court**.
 
• He assumed office as Chief Justice after being elevated from his position as a **Judge of the Madhya Pradesh High Court**.
 
• The **Punjab and Haryana High Court** is located in **Chandigarh** and has jurisdiction over the states of **Punjab, Haryana** and the Union Territory of **Chandigarh**.
 
• The Chief Justice is the **head of the judiciary** in the respective High Court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Justice Ravishankar Jha**:

 
 
• Former **Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana High Court**.
 
• Also served as Chief Justice of **Madhya Pradesh High Court**.
 
 
 
• **Justice Ritu Bahri**:
 
 
• Judge of the **Punjab and Haryana High Court**.
 
• Has served in various judicial capacities within the High Court.
 
 
 
• **Justice Krishna Murari**:
 
 
• Former **Judge of the Supreme Court of India**.
 
• Previously served as Chief Justice of the **Punjab and Haryana High Court**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Chief Justice of a High Court** is appointed by the **President of India** under **Article 217** of the Constitution.
 
• Punjab and Haryana High Court is one of the **oldest High Courts** in India.
 
• The High Court plays a crucial role in **upholding the Constitution** and protecting **fundamental rights**.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as Maharashtra’s first woman Deputy Chief Minister, and whom did she succeed in this position?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunetra Pawar, succeeding Ajit Pawar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Sunetra Pawar took oath as Maharashtra’s first woman Deputy Chief Minister, succeeding her husband Ajit Pawar, who died in a plane crash.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sunetra Pawar, aged 62, became the first woman to hold the post of Deputy Chief Minister in Maharashtra.**
 
• She took oath at **Lok Bhavan**, with the oath administered by the **Governor of Maharashtra**.
 
• She succeeded **Ajit Pawar**, former Deputy Chief Minister, who passed away on January 28.
 
• The swearing-in ceremony was attended by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis** and Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Deputy Chief Minister__

 __
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister assists the Chief Minister in state administration.
 
• The position is not constitutionally mandated but is created based on political and administrative requirements.
 
 
 
• Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)__
 __
 
• A major political party in Maharashtra founded by Sharad Pawar.
 
• Sunetra Pawar belongs to the NCP faction allied with the BJP and Shiv Sena.
 
 
 
• Rajya Sabha__
 __
 
• The Upper House of the Indian Parliament.
 
• Members are elected by the elected members of State Legislative Assemblies.
 
 
 
• Lok Bhavan__
 
 
• An official residence and venue for government functions in Maharashtra.
 
• Used for oath-taking ceremonies and important state events.

questions.question: Which scientist became the ISRO Chairman in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**V. Narayanan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **V. Narayanan** assumed the position of **ISRO Chairman** in **January 2025**, succeeding the previous chairman.
 
• He is a prominent scientist known for his contributions to India's **space research and development**, particularly in the field of **rocket propulsion systems**.
 
• As the Chairman of ISRO, V. Narayanan's role involves overseeing **national space missions**, strategic planning, and leading advancements in India's **space exploration** capabilities.
 
• **V. Narayanan** served as the Director of the **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC)**, a crucial ISRO center responsible for developing liquid propulsion systems for rockets and spacecraft.
 
• His appointment reflects his extensive experience and contributions to key space programs such as **PSLV, GSLV, and Chandrayaan missions**. Hence, the statement is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About ISRO:**

 
 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, established in **1969**, is India's national space agency headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• ISRO is responsible for developing **satellites, launch vehicles**, and conducting space exploration missions, contributing significantly to global space science.
 
 
 
• **Role of ISRO Chairman:**
 
 
• The ISRO Chairman oversees the planning and execution of space missions, including **scientific research, satellite launches**, and international collaborations.
 
• The Chairman ensures India's space programs align with the nation's strategic goals and technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **About V. Narayanan:**
 
 
• V. Narayanan is a veteran scientist in the field of **rocket propulsion systems**. He has played a crucial role in developing India's indigenous launch vehicles.
 
• He contributed to the success of major ISRO missions, including the **Chandrayaan** and **Mangalyaan** programs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **ISRO Achievements:**

 
 
• ISRO has launched several significant missions, including **Chandrayaan-2**, **Mangalyaan**, and the **PSLV-C37**, which deployed 104 satellites in a single launch.
 
• India's space program has established itself as a reliable and cost-effective option for satellite launches globally.
 
 
 
• **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC):**
 
 
• LPSC is a key ISRO facility responsible for developing **liquid propulsion systems**, critical for rockets and spacecraft.
 
• Under V. Narayanan's leadership, LPSC made significant advancements in propulsion technology, contributing to India's space capabilities.

questions.question: Who has been nominated as the next Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) in November 2025?

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the 9th Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission recently?

• **V. Ramasubramanian** was appointed as the 9th Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of India.
 
• The appointment was made in accordance with the provisions of the **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**.
 
• Justice V. Ramasubramanian is a former judge of the **Supreme Court of India**, where he served with distinction.
 
• The NHRC is an independent statutory body tasked with **protecting and promoting human rights** in India.
 
• Justice Ramasubramanian's appointment reflects the government’s focus on ensuring leadership at NHRC to address human rights concerns effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **S.P. Kurdukar**:

 
 
• S.P. Kurdukar is a former judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• He served during the 1990s and contributed to several landmark judgments during his tenure.

questions.question: In June 2025, who has become the first woman ADC (Aide-de-Camp) to the President of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashasvi Solanki**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yashasvi Solanki** has become the **first woman Aide-de-Camp (ADC)** to the President of India in **June 2025**.
 
• An **Aide-de-Camp (ADC)** is a personal assistant or aide to a senior military officer or head of state and serves as a prestigious designation.
 
• Her appointment marks a significant milestone in the **Indian Armed Forces**, as it demonstrates the growing representation of women in leadership and high-ranking positions.
 
• As an ADC to the President, her responsibilities include assisting the President in official ceremonies, functions, and day-to-day activities, along with liaising with military and civilian agencies.
 
• Her achievement is a testament to the **Indian Armed Forces' evolving inclusivity** and commitment to recognizing talent irrespective of gender.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aide-de-Camp (ADC) Role:**

 
 
• An ADC is a military officer who acts as a confidential assistant to a senior officer or dignitary, such as the President of India.
 
• They are generally selected from the **Indian Armed Forces**, including the Army, Navy, and Air Force, based on their exemplary service record and leadership skills.
 
• ADCs play a pivotal role in coordinating schedules, organizing events, and maintaining decorum during official functions.
 
 
 
• **Women in Armed Forces:**
 
 
• The appointment of women in higher and distinguished roles highlights **gender inclusivity** in the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• In recent years, several steps have been taken to **empower women** in the military, such as offering permanent commissions and leadership roles.
 
• Notable achievements include women being inducted as fighter pilots, commanding units, and now serving as ADCs to the President.
 
 
 
• **President's Secretariat:**
 
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces, and the ADC serves as a direct link between the President and the military.
 
• The ADC accompanies the President during official engagements, both within India and abroad.
 
 
 
• **Other Options in the Question:**
 
 
• **Neena Gupta:** Known as a celebrated actress in Indian cinema, she is not associated with the military or the ADC role.
 
• **Aliawati Longkumer:** While a notable name, there is no record of her serving as an ADC to the President.
 
• **Anuradha Thakur:** A senior bureaucrat, but not linked to the military or ADC appointments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of ADC Appointment:**

 
 
• The ADC role is a recognition of excellence and discipline in the armed forces.
 
• This position is highly prestigious and allows the officer to act as a direct representative of the President in military matters.
 
 
 
• **Milestones in Women Empowerment:**
 
 
• The appointment of women in roles such as ADC reflects the government's efforts towards **inclusivity** and **gender equality**.
 
• It also inspires future generations of women to pursue challenging and prestigious careers in the military.
